claim_text: Excessive preformed vitamin A (retinol) intake during pregnancy can cause fetal harm; total exposure and product form must be reviewed, distinguishing retinol from provitamin A carotenoids.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, indication-specific recommendations and avoid unsupported supplementation.

population.other_context: Pregnant people already using vitamin A-containing products.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary and supplemental forms; verify exact product label and formulation.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Vitamin A and pregnancy resources describe preformed vitamin A safety and upper limits.
limitations: No dose from this claim; exact formulation and total intake are essential.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
